Arts & Architecture · visual review

Six landscapes.
One connected world.

Relief concepts for the six advanced capital mats. Each study tests how joined impassable plots can become a single place with its own material, light and silhouette—while keeping the printed mat's defining features intact.

Concepts onlyFinal art and implementation wait for approval.

Open plots keep their grass, sand and island-edge beaches; the three printed volcanoes remain distinct land peaks within the sea mass.

Cloud districts retain their four printed tints. Scalloped pale rims remain visible where the cloud mass meets the sky.

Each specimen uses the same nine-by-nine join study: lone plot, side pair, both corner joins, L and 2×2. Capital mats are compared at the 425 px player-tab width; the original printed artwork is available under each concept.
